clue.text: Crave starter of burrito with melted cheese

explanation.surface: Someone hungry is craving a burrito topped with melted cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crave' reads as wanting food, but here it means to ask earnestly; 'starter' looks like a first course and 'melted' looks like cooking.
explanation.definitionFit: To crave can mean to ask for something humbly and urgently, the same as to implore or plead.

clue.text: Finance report on uncompleted work

explanation.walkthrough: 'Finance' looks like a noun about money, but it is the verb to fund, giving the word for supporting a project.
explanation.definitionFit: An accumulation of tasks still waiting to be dealt with is exactly what unfinished work piled up amounts to.

clue.text: Viewer's following celebrity astronomer

explanation.walkthrough: 'Viewer's' stands for 'viewer is', so the viewer word follows the celebrity word.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who looks at the night sky studying stars is informally called by this name, which also suits a professional astronomer.

clue.text: Just time for game, maybe

explanation.surface: There is just enough time to fit in a game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Just' looks like 'only', but it means fair or balanced. 'Maybe' flags that a game is one example of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A sporting contest such as a match is one example of an occasion or fixture on a programme.

clue.text: Random man's blown top with difficult to comprehend street map

indicators.note: to blow one's top is to lose one's head, so the opening letter is lost

explanation.definitionFit: Something done without plan, order or method is random, so the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: Inclined to back gloomy report

explanation.surface: Someone is inclined to support a depressing account.

explanation.definitionFit: Something slanting, at an angle rather than upright or level, is inclined, which is the geometric sense of the word.

explanation.walkthrough: 'Worker' is a crossword favourite for a hand, as on a farm or ship.

clue.text: Question remains after defeat

clue.text: Make bigger space, having left gear out

explanation.walkthrough: An en is a typesetting space, a common crossword convention.

clue.text: Irritate English fellow retiring after tea

indicators.note: after places one item later than another, setting the order of the pieces

F is the abbreviation for fellow

clue.text: Turning up with money trouble after Jack's sent down

clue.text: Long Island artist has night working outside in drizzle

clue.text: American soldier banks on Zoom with old device

taken as written

clue.text: Ginger and exotic plant cultivation

clue.text: Hiding tear, convinced King to admit defeat

clue.text: Crude comedy act's variable

clue.text: Cover victory in outstanding final part of report

clue.text: Fly high, capturing first light from the sun
